question: Which of the following cities hosted the 44th World Chess Olympiad in 2022?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Chennai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **44th World Chess Olympiad** was hosted by **Chennai** in 2022.
 
• This prestigious event took place in the city from July 28 to August 10, 2022.
 
• It was the first time that India hosted the Chess Olympiad, making it a significant milestone for the country.
 
• The event was held at the **Four Points by Sheraton Mahabalipuram Resort and Convention Centre**.
 
• The tournament saw participation from over **180 countries**, making it one of the largest events in the history of the Chess Olympiad.
 
• Chennai, also known as the **"Chess Capital of India"**, has a rich history and culture of chess, producing many grandmasters and international players.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Kolkata**__

 __
 
• Kolkata is the capital of the Indian state of West Bengal.
 
• It is known for its cultural heritage and colonial architecture.
 
 
 
• **Mumbai**__
 __
 
• Mumbai is the capital city of the Indian state of Maharashtra.
 
• It is the financial, commercial, and entertainment capital of India.
 
 
 
• **New Delhi**__
 
 
• New Delhi is the capital of India and serves as the seat of all three branches of the Government of India.
 
• It is known for its historical monuments and political significance.
